key_idea: The smallest slot is the minimum width of the convex polygon, and the minimum width is always attained with a supporting line flush with one edge.
sketch: For each edge, compute the maximum perpendicular distance of any vertex to the line through that edge (cross product divided by edge length); the answer is the minimum over edges. O(N^2) with N<=20. Pitfalls: reading real coordinates, do not assume the answer is a vertex-to-vertex distance; tolerance is 0.01 so doubles are ample.
